plan_sections.OVERVIEW: Build the useless-test pruner as a PlanGraph-developed, FeatureRun-hosted maintenance routine. Evidence tools select deletion candidates; a Codex-exec model seat performs only the bounded deletion.
plan_sections.BACKENDS: Every build-time and runtime model seat runs on the Codex exec backend via the agent-mixture provider map; the human-side operator loop is the only exception.
plan_sections.TP-01: Mutation engine core: deterministic stdlib-ast mutant enumeration with stable mutant IDs and a fixed classical operator set. Pure enumeration, no execution.
plan_sections.TP-02: Mutant execution and scoring: temp-tree materialization, scoped unittest subprocess runs with hard budgets, killed/survived/timeout/error/budget-exhausted classification, and the test-pruner-report/1 schema.
plan_sections.TP-03: Static vacuity detector: flags assert-free, tautological, and mock-neutralized tests; must produce zero unreviewed flags on the repository's current suite.
plan_sections.TP-04: Candidate selector and routine policy: merge mutation and static evidence into at most five ranked deletion candidates with full evidence chains; author the static-plane policy document.
plan_sections.TP-05: All-codex runtime wiring: FeatureRun dispatch of the bounded deletion with codex-exec coordinator, implementer, reviewer, and repair seats; candidate-only integration; PlanGraph launcher variant.
plan_sections.TP-06: Pilot and audit evidence: planted fixture corpus, end-to-end selection accuracy assertion, post-deletion green suite, and a recorded pilot report artifact.

acceptance_criteria.AC-ENG-1: Mutant enumeration is deterministic, stdlib-only, refuses out-of-root targets, and produces stable mutant IDs across repeated invocations.
acceptance_criteria.AC-ENG-2: Mutant execution runs each mutant in an isolated subprocess against a scoped test selection under hard per-mutant and total budgets; exhaustion is reported as budget-exhausted, never silently truncated.
acceptance_criteria.AC-RPT-1: Every pruner report validates against schemas/test-pruner-report.schema.json and records per-test attribution method, mutant counts, statuses, budgets, environment fingerprint, and target commit.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DET-1: The static detector flags planted assert-free, tautological, and mock-neutralized tests in its own fixtures and raises zero unreviewed flags against the repository's current suite.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SEL-1: The selector emits at most five deletion candidates per run, each backed by an evidence chain free of timeout, error, budget-exhausted, or fallback-attribution contamination, and the routine policy document exists.
acceptance_criteria.AC-RUN-1: Runtime wiring resolves every model seat to the codex-exec provider, confines the deletion lane's writable paths to tests/**, and forces candidate-only integration.
acceptance_criteria.AC-PIL-1: On the planted fixture corpus the pruner selects exactly the planted vacuous tests, genuine tests survive, the fixture suite passes after deletion, and the pilot report is recorded as a reviewable artifact.

runs.objective: Create the deterministic stdlib-only mutant enumeration engine in scripts/dev/mutation_check.py with unit tests.
Create the isolated mutant execution and budgeted scoring engine on top of the TP-01 enumeration API, plus the test-pruner-report/1 schema.
Create the static vacuity detector for assert-free, tautological, and mock-neutralized tests, verified against fixtures and the current suite.
Create the evidence-merging candidate selector with a five-candidate cap and author the routine's static-plane policy document.
Create the all-codex FeatureRun wiring and PlanGraph launcher that turn a selector report into a bounded deletion-only candidate branch.
Create the planted fixture corpus and end-to-end pilot proving selection accuracy and post-deletion suite health, recording the pilot report artifact.
